SUBJ/SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL WEATHER ADVISORY FOR THE INDIAN OCEAN 
REISSUED/191230Z-191800ZOCT2026//
RMKS/
1. NORTH INDIAN OCEAN AREA (MALAY PENINSULA WEST TO COAST OF AFRICA):
   A. TROPICAL CYCLONE SUMMARY: NONE.
   B. TROPICAL DISTURBANCE SUMMARY:
      (1) THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 96A) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 
4.0N 57.0E HAS DISSIPATED AND IS NO LONGER SUSPECT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT 
OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE IN THE NEXT 24 HOURS.
      (2) NO OTHER SUSPECT AREAS.
   C. SUBTROPICAL SYSTEM SUMMARY: NONE.
2. SOUTH INDIAN OCEAN AREA (135E WEST TO COAST OF AFRICA):
   A. TROPICAL CYCLONE SUMMARY: NONE.
   B. TROPICAL DISTURBANCE SUMMARY: 
      (1) THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 93S) HAS PERSISTED NEAR 3.2N 
57.1E, APPROXIMATELY 100 NM NORTHEAST OF SEYCHELLES. ANIMATED ENHANCED 
INFRARED IMAGERY (EIR) DEPICTS AN AREA OF PARTIALLY EXPOSED, BROAD 
TURNING ON THE NORTHEASTERN SIDE WHILE THE SOUTHWESTERN FLANK IS 
OBSCURED BY FLARING CONVECTION. AN 181723Z METOP-B ASCAT PASS DEPICTS 
AN AREA OF ELONGATED TURNING WITH ENHANCED WINDS ON THE NORTHERN AND 
SOUTHERN SIDES, SOMEWHAT DISPLACED FROM THE ASSESSED CENTER OF 
TURNING. AN 182117Z AMSR3 MICROWAVE PASS DEPICTS AN ELONGATED BUT 
CONSOLIDATING LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION (LLC). ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS 
REVEALS LOW TO MODERATE VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (15-20KTS), WARM SEA 
SURFACE TEMPERATURES (28-29C), AND MODERATE RADIAL OUTFLOW ALOFT. 
GLOBAL MODELS ARE IN AGREEMENT ON 93S TRACKING SOUTHWESTWARD. MAXIMUM 
SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED BETWEEN 18-22 KTS. MINIMUM SEA 
LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1010MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE 
DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS 
REMAINS LOW. 
   (2) NO OTHER SUSPECT AREAS.
   C. SUBTROPICAL SYSTEM SUMMARY: NONE.
3. JUSTIFICATION FOR REISSUE: DISSIPATED AREA IN PARA. 1.B.(1).//
